dune-part-two.title: Dune: Part Two
dune-part-two.synopsis: Paul Atreides joins Chani and the Fremen in the deep desert, waging a guerrilla war against the forces that destroyed his family. As visions of a holy war grow sharper, he must choose between the woman he loves and the destiny an entire planet is waiting for.

inside-out-2.title: Inside Out 2
inside-out-2.synopsis: Riley is thirteen, hockey camp is looming, and Headquarters is suddenly under renovation. When Anxiety and a crew of brand-new emotions move in, Joy and the original team must find a way to protect the girl Riley is becoming.

interstellar.title: Interstellar
interstellar.synopsis: With crops failing and dust swallowing the Earth, a former pilot leaves his children behind to lead a mission through a wormhole near Saturn. Every hour on the far side costs years at home, and the clock is racing against the people he loves.

across-the-spider-verse.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
across-the-spider-verse.synopsis: Miles Morales is pulled across the Multiverse and into a society of Spider-People sworn to protect reality itself. When they clash over how to handle a new threat, Miles has to decide what being a hero really means, and rewrite the rules if he has to.

oppenheimer.title: Oppenheimer
oppenheimer.synopsis: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer, the brilliant and contradictory physicist who led the race to build the atomic bomb, and the political reckoning that followed once the world understood what he had made.

your-name.title: Your Name.
your-name.synopsis: A high-school girl in a quiet mountain town and a boy in central Tokyo begin waking up in each other's bodies. Their messages become a friendship, then something deeper, until a comet in the night sky changes everything.

top-gun-maverick.title: Top Gun: Maverick
top-gun-maverick.synopsis: After thirty years of pushing limits, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell returns to train an elite group of young pilots for a near-impossible mission, including the son of his late best friend, who still blames him for the past.

everything-everywhere.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
everything-everywhere.synopsis: An exhausted laundromat owner in the middle of a tax audit discovers she can tap into the lives of her parallel selves. To save the multiverse, she will need every version of herself, and a new kind of kindness.

avengers-doomsday.title: Avengers: Doomsday
avengers-doomsday.synopsis: Earth's mightiest heroes reunite against a new sovereign of the Multiverse: Victor von Doom. Old allies, new faces and the Fantastic Four must stand together when an entire reality is on the line.

dune-part-three.title: Dune: Part Three
dune-part-three.synopsis: Years after his rise to power, Emperor Paul Atreides faces conspiracies inside his own court as the holy war fought in his name spreads across the stars. The final chapter of Denis Villeneuve's Dune saga.

beyond-the-spider-verse.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
beyond-the-spider-verse.synopsis: Miles Morales is trapped in the wrong universe, face to face with a version of himself he never imagined. The concluding chapter of the Spider-Verse trilogy.
